## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --lib` passes (in `src-tauri`)
- [ ] `node --check ui/app.js` passes
- [ ] Checked in the `--simulate` demo (Simple and Advanced view, dark and light theme) if the UI changed
- [ ] Follows the [rules for code that runs as administrator](../CONTRIBUTING.md#rules-for-code-that-runs-as-administrator)
- [ ] New network destinations, if any, are listed in `PRIVACY.md`
- [ ] No personal data, keys or machine-specific paths in the change
